Contract review for card #30814 · governed ADR text (`docs/adr/**`) · read-only reviewer at the contract-review tier, brief per `record-recognisers --brief-template --paths` · 2026-11-06T06:09Z

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9f78f24c9cbfd884dcbe517b7f5988818c83ae9b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md + packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts (the live code the new §A.5 note makes claims about; the ADR's own `packages/spec/src/cloud/package.zod.ts` path has since moved to `marketplace/`). Citations read on GitHub: #1825 comment 5226411687, PR #6671, PR #6864, #6760 comment 5228813333. objectstack-ai/cloud#1927 is unreachable from this session and stays unverified.

### ① Derived judgments

- File list: one path, `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`, +19 / −2, three hunks (head lines 8, 370–375, 724–734). The PR base `2038c56e` and the local checkout both carry blob `3a84eeea` for this file, so the files-API patch IS the net diff against `main`; the branch holds one commit, `9f78f24c`. No second file, no hidden hunk.
- Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H. The PR is draft, unarmed, unqueued; the dev opened it and stopped, as Prime Directive #14 and Post-Task #2 require. Right.
- Accept-set change: none. No Zod schema, no `packages/**`, no generated artifact, no authorable-surface entry, no skill, no workflow, no retired key. Dev's `Metadata-protocol: none` — right.
- Public-surface change: none. Dev's `Clause-②: no`, no arm — right. A `(narrowing)` or `(widening)` arm would have been wrong on this diff.
- Check-runs on `9f78f24c`: 46 runs, 26 success, 20 skipped (opt-in and path-filtered lanes), 0 failure, 0 pending. Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, PR-body guards: success. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; the 21-command local table in the PR body is the dev's reporting and was not re-run here.

### ② Semver level

- No changeset in the diff; the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR (sent on the create, present on read). Correct: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing from any released package, so `skip-changeset` is the only right declaration and a `patch` changeset would have been malformed.
- PR body carries line-initial `Clause-②: no` (no arm) and `Metadata-protocol: none`; both match a diff that publishes nothing. Check Changeset: success. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []` — nothing to answer. The four out-of-scope stale lines, each verified in the head tree:

1. §A.6 still reads `[proposed] Phase A1` (head line 740) although A1 landed on 2026-08-09 by PR #6864 (merged, 8 files: `namespace` on both publish schemas, CLI read, tests, changeset). Outside the claim's pinned file surface (line 8, line 370, one note under §A.5); escalated in the PR's Acceptance notes. Escalated — but the PR's own note now says "Phase A1 is landed" (head line 731) nine lines above that bullet, an adjacency this PR creates. Carried as ④ should-fix 1; not a FAIL.
2. The header `Addenda` line (8) lists only the 2026-08-08 addendum; the 2026-10-08 addendum (head line 780, Accepted) is named in line 3's status but has no header entry. Incomplete, not false; out of scope; escalated. Accepted as escalated.
3. §A.0 "Publish time has zero namespace surface" is self-dated ("verified against `main`, 2026-08-08") and superseded by #6864. True as dated, labelled as a measurement; out of scope; escalated. Accepted as escalated.
4. #6760's claim comment (5228813333) cites "#1825 comment 5226117769"; that id answers 404 and the real acceptance comment is 5226411687. A GitHub comment, not repository text — nothing in the tree to edit. Accepted as noted.

Dev deviations: (1) objectstack-ai/cloud#1927 could not be read — handled honestly: the PR body says so in both the Acceptance notes and the 维护者速读, cites it exactly as the card body (the maintainer's filing, epic:#3600#1) cites it, and asks the Tier H approver to confirm before merging. This review could not reach that repository either; the claim rests on the card's authority. See ④ should-fix 3 on the ADR wording. (2)–(4) (reviewer request left to the seat; model-free commit trailer pair; PR template mirrored) are procedural and touch no tree content; PR-body guards and the lint lanes are green.

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`, judged against the code it cites in the live tree and against the scenario it is accepted against: the maintainer's 「同意」 on #30814 to correct the record only and not to build the exclusivity gate.

Holds:

- Hunks 1 and 2 (lines 8, 370–375): the acceptance record exists and says what the ADR now says. #1825 comment 5226411687, created 2026-08-08T13:55Z, opens "Maintainer ruling (2026-08-08, via the engine-core PM session): ADR-0048 addendum ACCEPTED as drafted, including the two flagged extensions — D2 ... and D3 rule 2", and states "The in-document status line reads 'Proposed' at merge time; this comment is the acceptance record of authority, and the status-line flip rides the next docs touch". PR #6671 is merged 2026-08-08T14:23Z, one file (this ADR, +396). Every fact in the two status lines — date, 13:55Z, "as drafted", "D2 and D3 rule 2 included", "landed it the same day", "still reading Proposed", "record of authority until the line caught up" — traces to that comment and that PR. Line 8's "additive to §3.2, supersedes nothing" and line 375's "It is **additive to §3.2** and **supersedes no text above** …" are kept verbatim: the status lines move no decision text.
- §A.5 note, "Phase A2 ... stays bound to this precondition: it lands before third-party publishing opens, and the opening waits for it." A.5 already rules that the check "MUST land before third-party publishing opens. It is an acceptance criterion for opening third-party publishing, not a follow-up to it", quoting 「三方 publisher 开放前必须完成 namespace→publisher 唯一性检查」, and A.6 marks A2 "This is the item bound by §A.5." "The opening waits for it" restates "acceptance criterion for opening"; it adds no decision the addendum does not already contain.
- §A.5 note, D2 + D4: D4 rule 1 reads "When the registry is switched on, back-fill it ... award the reservation to the publisher of the earliest published version carrying it (first-come)"; D2 reads "The reservation is held by the publisher, not by the package". The note's gloss — "the back-fill awards each published namespace to the publisher of its earliest published version, and the reservation is held by that publisher" — is those two sentences, and D4's own closing paragraph already expects that "at switch-on the corpus is first-party plus internal". The account matches the addendum's D2/D4 text.
- §A.5 note, "Phase A1 is landed ... carries `namespace` on the publish payload in this repository, read off the artifact's `manifest.namespace`": in the live tree `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts` lines 196–205 put `namespace` on `PackageSchema` (regex `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$/`, "mirrors manifest.namespace") and line 304 sets `namespace: PackageSchema.shape.namespace` on `CreatePackageRequestSchema`; `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` `readArtifactNamespace()` (line 209) reads `artifact?.manifest?.namespace`, line 558 refuses a malformed value before any network call, line 619 `if (namespace) pkgBody.namespace = namespace` sends it. The claim holds against the code.
- Scenario: no gate was built. `NAMESPACE_ALREADY_RESERVED` / `NAMESPACE_RESERVED_PLATFORM` occur nowhere in the tree outside the ADR's own §A.2 pseudo-code, and the diff touches no code. "Correct the record only" is honoured.
- The note's heading "no decision changes" is true: D1–D6, §A.2–A.4, A.6, A.7 are untouched; the note is a blockquote appended after A.5's prose, and A.5's normative text (the MUST and the quoted ruling) stands intact.

Should-fix (none blocking):

1. The note's "Phase A1 is landed" (head line 731) now stands nine lines above A.6's "[proposed] Phase A1" (head line 740). The contradiction is new to this PR, not inherited. The fix is a one-word `[done]` flip of that bullet, by the owning seat on this PR under the approver's word, or as a follow-up card; the record as written stays correct (the note is dated, the bullet is the stale one).
2. "first-party namespaces are reserved at switch-on by D2 and D4" names the mechanism for reservable namespaces only. The whitelist set `base`/`system`/`sys` is, by D3 rule 1, "never reserved" (no reservation written, none consulted) and is protected by D3 rule 2 (first-party tier only). A reader could take the sentence to say `sys` receives a D4 reservation, which D3 forbids. The ADR is not contradicted — D3 stands verbatim above, and "no separate official reserved list is needed" remains true because the whitelist is already the install gate's constant — but "(the D3 whitelist aside, which is never reserved and is tier-restricted)" would make the sentence exact. The wording is the card's ask, reproduced; precision, not a decision.
3. "objectstack-ai/cloud#1927 is its cloud-side half" states as record a relation this repository cannot verify and that A.6 does not define (A.6 and the acceptance comment place A1 "open-side, this repo"). §A.0/§A.2 make an enterprise-side receiver of the payload field implicit, and the card body — the maintainer's filing — names cloud#1927 as part of A1's landing, so the claim is on the card's authority and the note carries `#30814` as its citation. Honest in the PR body; in the ADR text "on the cloud side (per #30814)" would carry the provenance rather than assert the "half". The Tier H approver confirms it before the click, as the PR asks.

No must-fix found.

Delta record over 6678388633 (PASS on `9f78f24c9cbfd884dcbe517b7f5988818c83ae9b`). Findings carried forward unchanged are marked as such.

### ① Derived judgments

- Delta: the compare is `ahead_by 1, behind_by 0`, one commit `8c648855` (committed 2026-11-06, "docs(adr): fold the contract review's three should-fixes into ADR-0048", model-free trailer pair), one file, +8 / −7, two hunks: the §A.5 note (head lines 728–735) and the §A.6 Phase A1 bullet (head lines 741–744). - Net diff against `main`: still one path, `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`, now +22 / −4 in four hunks (head lines 8, 370–375, 724–736, 741–744). Base sha `2038c56e` is unchanged; `main` has moved to `ae82d057` but carries the same blob `3a84eeea` for this file, and the local checkout carries it too, so the files-API patch IS the net diff. Head blob `a679e860` matches the contents API at `8c648855`. The branch holds two commits, `9f78f24c` then `8c648855`.
- Widened surface: the re-posted claim 6678359816 widens the file surface to "the §A.6 Phase A1 bullet `[proposed]` → `[done]` per the contract review's should-fix 1". The delta's two hunks sit inside the widened surface (the note under §A.5, the A1 bullet); nothing outside it moved. ⛔-list intact: no code, no other ADR, no `packages/**`, no `skills/**`.
- Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H. The PR is draft, `auto_merge: null`, no requested reviewers, zero reviews, unqueued; the dev pushed and stopped, as Prime Directive #14 and Post-Task #2 require. Carried forward: right.
- Accept-set change: none (carried forward — a prose-only delta). Dev's `Metadata-protocol: none` — right.
- Public-surface change: none (carried forward). Dev's `Clause-②: no`, no arm — right.
- Check-runs on `8c648855`: 41 runs, 25 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure, 0 pending; commit status API `pending` with zero contexts (nothing reports there). Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Check PR Size: success. Build Core, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI and the UI/dogfood matrices: skipped, path-filtered on a docs-only diff, as on the prior head. One difference from `9f78f24c`: Check Changeset is `skipped` on this head (it was `success` before); the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and a skipped lane is not a red. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; the 21-command local table in the dev's round-2 addendum (6678764595) is the dev's reporting and was not re-run here.

### ② Semver level

Carried forward unchanged: no changeset in the diff; `skip-changeset` label present (labels now `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`); `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing from any released package, so `skip-changeset` is the only right declaration. PR body still carries line-initial `Clause-②: no` (no arm) and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the delta adds nothing that publishes. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []` on both dev reports — nothing to answer.

The three should-fix items of the prior record, judged against the new text:

1. **Should-fix 1 — closed as asked.** The §A.6 bullet now reads `**[done] Phase A1 — carry the namespace to publish.**` with "Landed by PR #6864 (2026-08-09)." appended (head lines 741–744); the bullet's description ("`namespace` on `PackageSchema` / `CreatePackageRequestSchema`; `objectstack package publish` reads it off the artifact manifest. Open-side, this repo. Prerequisite for everything below.") is byte-unchanged. The prior record asked for "a one-word `[done]` flip of that bullet, by the owning seat on this PR"; it was done under the widened claim 6678359816, which names exactly that bullet. The adjacency contradiction (note at head line 733 "Phase A1 is landed" nine lines above a `[proposed]` bullet) no longer exists.
2. **Should-fix 2 — closed as asked.** The note now reads "reserved at switch-on by D2 and D4 (the D3 whitelist aside, which is never reserved and stays first-party-tier only): the back-fill awards …" (head lines 728–732). The prior record proposed "(the D3 whitelist aside, which is never reserved and is tier-restricted)"; the landed wording is that parenthesis with "tier-restricted" made concrete. Verified against D3 in ④.
3. **Should-fix 3 — closed as asked.** "objectstack-ai/cloud#1927 is its cloud-side half" is gone; the note now reads "with its cloud-side receiver in objectstack-ai/cloud#1927 (per #30814)" (head lines 734–735). The provenance the prior record asked for is carried in the text. Residual, unchanged from the prior record: this session cannot read objectstack-ai/cloud, so whether #1927 is that receiver rests on the card body (the maintainer's filing, epic:#3600#1); the PR body still asks the Tier H approver to confirm it before the click.

Out-of-scope stale lines, carried forward from the prior record with the first one now resolved:

- Prior item 1 (§A.6 `[proposed] Phase A1`): resolved by this delta — see should-fix 1 above.
- Prior item 2 (header `Addenda` line 8 lists only the 2026-08-08 addendum, not the 2026-10-08 one): unchanged in the head tree (line 8 still names one addendum); incomplete, not false; out of scope; accepted as escalated — the dev's round-2 addendum lists it again as noted, not filed.
- Prior item 3 (§A.0 "Publish time has zero namespace surface", self-dated "verified against `main`, 2026-08-08", head line 412): unchanged; true as dated, labelled as a measurement. The `[done]` flip at A.6 does not make it worse than the note already did: the ADR now records, in three dated places (A.0 at 2026-08-08, the §A.5 note and the A.6 bullet at 2026-11-06 / 2026-08-09), that the surface was absent on 2026-08-08 and present from 2026-08-09, which is consistent. Accepted as escalated.
- Prior item 4 (#6760's claim comment cites comment id 5226117769, the real id is 5226411687): a GitHub comment, not repository text; nothing in the tree to edit. Carried forward.

Dev deviations, carried forward: (1) cloud#1927 unreadable, handled honestly in the PR body and now in the ADR text's "(per #30814)"; (2)–(4) procedural, touch no tree content. New this round: none reported; the round-2 addendum states "Still draft, not readied, no reviewers requested", which the PR read confirms.

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` at `8c648855`, judged against the ADR's own decision text and the code it cites, and against the scenario it is accepted against: the maintainer's 「同意」 on #30814 to correct the record only and not to build the exclusivity gate.

Carried forward unchanged (the delta does not touch these lines): hunks 1 and 2 (lines 8, 370–375) trace every fact to #1825 comment 5226411687 (created 2026-08-08, "ADR-0048 addendum ACCEPTED as drafted, including the two flagged extensions — D2 ... and D3 rule 2", "the status-line flip rides the next docs touch") and to PR #6671 (merged 2026-08-08, this file alone, +396); "additive to §3.2, supersedes nothing" and "It is **additive to §3.2** and **supersedes no text above** …" are kept verbatim. The note's A2 sentence restates A.5's own MUST ("acceptance criterion for opening third-party publishing, not a follow-up to it") and A.6's "This is the item bound by §A.5." The D2 + D4 gloss is D4 rule 1 ("back-fill … award the reservation to the publisher of the earliest published version carrying it") and D2 ("The reservation is held by the publisher, not by the package"). The Phase A1 code claim holds against `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts` (`namespace` on `PackageSchema`, re-used on `CreatePackageRequestSchema`) and `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` (`readArtifactNamespace()` reads `artifact?.manifest?.namespace`, refuses a malformed value before any network call, sends it). No gate was built: `NAMESPACE_ALREADY_RESERVED` / `NAMESPACE_RESERVED_PLATFORM` occur nowhere outside the ADR's §A.2 pseudo-code, and the diff touches no code.

New text, re-checked against the ADR itself and the live tree:

- **D3 whitelist parenthesis against D3 rule 1 and rule 2.** D3 (head lines 487–506) defines the set as `base`, `system`, `sys` — "`RESERVED_NAMESPACES ∪ {'sys'}`, the identical set `isShareableNamespace()` already exempts" — and gives two rules. Rule 1: "**They are never reserved and never conflict.** A publish carrying one of them neither creates a reservation nor consults one". Rule 2: "**They are restricted by publisher tier, not by first-come.** Only `publisher: 'objectstack'` (the first-party tier already in `PackagePublisherSchema`) may publish a package whose namespace is in the whitelist. Anyone else is rejected." The note's "which is never reserved" is rule 1's first clause verbatim; "stays first-party-tier only" is rule 2's "Only … the first-party tier … Anyone else is rejected", with "stays" marking that the note changes nothing. The parenthesis excludes the whitelist from "reserved at switch-on by D2 and D4", which is what rule 1 requires (no reservation is written for it, so the D4 back-fill cannot award one), and it does not reopen the trap D3 names ("conflating the two"): the two properties are stated as two, in rule order. The sentence that follows — "So no separate official reserved list is needed" — remains true on both halves: reservable first-party namespaces are covered by the D4 back-fill, the unreservable platform set by the whitelist constant the install gate already holds. D3's own text is untouched. Exact; no decision moves.
- **"[done] Phase A1 … Landed by PR #6864 (2026-08-09)" against PR #6864.** The pulls API answers `merged: true`, `merged_at` 2026-08-09, merge commit `4cc4fb7e`, title "feat(spec,cli): carry the package namespace on the publish payload (ADR-0048 addendum Phase A1)", eight files: `packages/spec/src/cloud/package.zod.ts` (+35), `packages/spec/src/cloud/template-manifest.zod.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` (+52), two tests, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/cloud.json`, `content/docs/references/cloud/package.mdx`, a changeset. That is the bullet's own description of A1 (`namespace` on both publish schemas; the CLI reads it off the artifact manifest; open-side, this repo), so `[done]` is earned under §5's legend ("**[done]** shipped", line 318, which A.6 adopts by "Status legend as in §5") and the date is the merge date. Holds. The same date and PR number appear in the §A.5 note; the two agree.
- **"cloud-side receiver … (per #30814)".** The ADR already places the consumer of the publish payload outside this repository: "**The marketplace review pipeline** (enterprise-side, outside this repo)" (head line 424), A.6's A2 "Enterprise-side", and §A.5's "lets the enterprise-side implementation be scheduled". "Receiver" names that role in the ADR's own framing rather than asserting a "half" of A1 that A.6 does not define (A.6 keeps A1 "Open-side, this repo", unchanged). "(per #30814)" carries the provenance, as asked. Which cloud item fills the role is still unverifiable from here and remains the approver's confirmation — the PR body says so.
- **Does the delta move any decision text or create a new contradiction?** D1–D6, §A.0–A.4, A.7 and the two status lines are byte-identical between `9f78f24c` and `8c648855` (the compare shows exactly the two hunks above). The note's heading "no decision changes" stays true. A1 is now consistently "landed" in the note and `[done]` in A.6; A2, A3 remain `[proposed]`, A4 `[deferred]`, the non-goal unchanged, so A.6's "Prerequisite for everything below" still reads correctly with A1 done and the rest open. The sole remaining tension in the file is A.0's dated measurement against A1's landing, which pre-exists this PR, is self-dated, and is carried as escalated above. No new contradiction.
- **Scenario.** Still "correct the record only": the delta is 15 prose lines in one ADR, no gate, no schema, no skill, no workflow.

Should-fix: none remaining. Must-fix: none found.
